tests.description: An array pattern with no rest requires an exact length: a longer array no longer matches, the exact one still does, a shorter one never did.
A rest binder keeps the at-least reading and still binds zero elements.
A nested array pattern gets the same exact-length rule.
The is operator and while conditions route through the same lowering, so they change with match arms.
tests.expectedOutput: ["is fell through","is matched","while fell through","while matched"]
